title: Watson's Binary-Rank Conjecture Is False: Kronecker Powers of a Rank-Five 0/1 Matrix Need Only 4^(k+o(k)) Rectangles
description: Watson (2016) conjectured that the binary rank of the k-th Kronecker power of a particular 5 × 6 matrix M is 5k for all k. We show 4k ≤ br(M⊗k) ≤ 4k(k+1)(⌊2.41k⌋+1) for every k. In particular br(M⊗33) ≤ 433·1431 < 533, so the conjecture fails for every k ≥ 33, and the asymptotic rate is exactly 4, the nonnegative rank of M. The construction applies to the incidence matrix of any loopless multigraph with an extra all-ones column, and it also gives rate exactly 4 for Shitov's 5 × 5 matrix. The disproof at k = 33 and the lower bound are machine-checked in Lean 4 with Mathlib; a standalone verifier (verify.py) checks the construction for small k and the counting inequalities. Research note; not peer-reviewed.
